criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, original directed topology/winding, source reopen, two real separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, transformed counts/dimensions, true-solid contacts and whole-scene exposure.

Retain one-row hooked hollow tubes and gentle basal curve. Correct enlarged conical basal ornament to conservative sicula and avoid independent separated hooks; overlap is required. Color is artistic, not pyrite fossil color. Personally inspect eight final512px views and lossless sheet; same-subject details for microscopic apertures.

One row of eighteen long overlapping hooked thecal tubes on a slender proximally dorsally curved then straight stipe. Thecae extend distally before curving proximally; terminal apertures face toward proximal lower end. No coil, second row or isolated tooth geometry. Solid-wall lumens remain visible from appropriate low/oblique same-subject views; long thecae overlap along the axial colony rather than merely separate free hooks. M.priodon SMF75780 relief specimen and current expert diagnosis; extends chosen colony growth beyond the preserved fragment, explicitly reconstructive.
